improvement.note: Magnification above 1.0 means the texture is upscaled on screen. At the R3 hold (166 km across the frame) the rejected checkpoint's source would be upscaled about 44.7x and the 500 m Blue Marble window alone 4.24x; the ground structure the viewer actually resolves comes from the 30 m detail multiplier, sampled at 0.35x, i.e. the frame sees more structure texels than delivered pixels. Colour remains Blue Marble at 500 m by design: the multiplier adds structure, not colour.

method: Frame width at the AOI from shot_plan.analyze on the last camera keyframe; texel size from each texture's equirectangular dimensions with the east-west size scaled by cos(latitude); magnification = metres per texel / metres per delivered pixel. The active texture under the target is the detail window wherever the frame lies inside it, which it does at the hold by construction.
